title: benchhand CEL expression types, provisional
description: Provisional: the CEL expression types (ADR-0014). Every CEL field of every contract refers to CelExpression or CelExpressions here, and that $ref is how the flow interpreter finds them all

CelExpression.description: A CEL expression. A standalone one, in flow.yaml or a policy contribution, is checked at load by cel-expr-python against the activation types generated from the contracts; one in a rule list is compiled before load by the pinned cel-go tool (ADR-0020). The schema only checks that it is a non-empty string. x-cel is a readable annotation that nothing depends on

CelExpressions.description: One or more CEL expressions, each of which must hold
